stops.note: the vernacular form of the Sanskrit gem name
Greek traders adopted the Indian word for the gem
carried into Latin by the Roman gem trade
passed into French before reaching English
settled as the English name for the mineral family that includes emerald and aquamarine
stops.meaning: a pale green to blue-green mineral, source of emerald and aquamarine

current_meaning: A mineral (beryllium aluminum silicate) whose gem varieties include emerald and aquamarine.
